scripts.dev: npm run build -w @scrum-poker/shared && concurrently -n shared,back,front -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @scrum-poker/shared" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @scrum-poker/shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm test -w @scrum-poker/shared && npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
scripts.prepare: sh -c 'if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then git config core.hooksPath .githooks; fi'
